54:32.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

54:33.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.

54:34.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

54:35.text: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

54:36.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

54:37.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes,

54:38.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

54:39.text: So taste My punishment and warning.

54:40.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

54:41.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

54:42.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
